item.title: Heartbeat of Iceland
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Mystery/Horror

Page Layout: ACS header, basic layout, tons of audio recordings and exploration logs

Elevator Pitch: Series of sounds that resemble heartbeats, only found in deep lakes in Iceland, each with varying frequencies and loudness. The sounds are quite rare and cause mishaps in reality in a wide area around it.

Central Narrative: The heartbeats last for 20-75 seconds, and range in frequency, loudness, and location. Heartbeats are relatively rare (1-3 times a year) but can be very troubling for the area around it.

Heartbeats come in pairs of 2 "pumps", in this case, sound. Once a heartbeat starts, the pumps cause vibrations in the land, seemingly wavy land. Everything the sound can be heard is effected.
Here's a list of each possible reality-bending scenario

  • Vibrations in the land (wavy-like land)
  • Mountains deforming in a very unnatural way
  • Water vortexes
  • "cracks" in the air, where a black spot fills the crack
  • Clouds taking shape of humanoid figures
  • Talbon's Ring (a high-frequency ring that burst eardrums and rarely kills an organism)
  • The sky turning into dark, even during bright days
  • Temperature suddenly shooting up or increasing drastically
  • Altered heartbeats of humans (matches the lake's heartbeat)

These are the only known effects of the heartbeat, but in later logs, more will appear (creepier and deadlier). A heartbeat can have serious effects on the ecosystem, and cause mass death amongst organisms, and heavily deformed land.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A decent reality-bender that has some good potential, even though it probably has a LOT to work on.

Additional Notes: Suggestions for editing needed :)
